backend/main.mo: Motoko canister storing user-specific liquidity lines and boxes with CRUD operations and retrieval queries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence metadata listing liquidity-related frontend files, components, and requirement mappings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer defining global OKLCH color tokens and theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component applying theming and rendering the LiquidityMapper page with notifications.
Monthly BTC candlestick chart rendering candles and liquidity lines/boxes using Recharts.
frontend/src/components/ChartStates.tsx: UI components for loading, error, and empty chart states with retry support.
frontend/src/features/data/fetchUtils.ts: Utility functions for fetching market data with timeout handling, errors, and JSON parsing.
frontend/src/features/data/types.ts: Type definitions for Candle plus helpers for normalizing Binance and CoinGecko data.
frontend/src/features/data/useMonthlyCan: Fetches BTC monthly candles using Binance with CoinGecko fallback, wrapped in a React Query hook.
frontend/src/features/liquidity/liquidit: Implements liquidity detection logic including candle direction, reversal structures, box states, and model computation.
frontend/src/features/liquidity/types.ts: Defines TypeScript types for liquidity lines, boxes, their states, and the overall liquidity model.
frontend/src/features/liquidity/useLiqui: Wraps liquidity model computation in a memoized hook using candle data.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication and client creation.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines backend candle fetching via React Query using the authenticated actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets global Tailwind-based theme, colors, and utility styles for the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/LiquidityMapperPage.t: Page component that loads monthly candles and renders the BTC liquidity chart with loading and error states.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom fonts, OKLCH-based color variables, extended utilities, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: JSON describing the project's versioned state, including app purpose, architecture notes, known issues, and a list of existing feature definitions.
